name: Code eval v1
description: Runs all 140 items of eval-code-v1 at temperature 0 and reports accuracy overall, by category and by difficulty. Pinned together with the dataset: a change to either means a new -v2 id.

eval.notes: Runs untrusted model output. Execute in a subprocess with no network, a throwaway working directory and the row's meta.timeout_s (default 10 s), never in the harness process.

notes: accuracy and avg_latency_ms live in the result's `scores` block, not in `metrics`; success_rate is the share of requests that completed at all and is independent of whether the answers were right.
